blocks.text: LONDON, United Kingdom — Prince Harry attended a Remembrance Sunday event in a small English town, far from Britain’s main ceremony honoring the country’s war dead, led by his father, King Charles III. Ceremonies are held at war memorials across Britain on the Sunday closest to Armistice Day, Nov. 11, which marks the peace agreement that ended World War I. The Sun and the Daily Mail tabloids posted photos online of former British Army captain Harry, dressed in a dark suit and wearing military medals, chatting with locals at an event in Brackley, Northamptonshire, north of London.
